Home API hold expects an h-dvh skeleton; real SDK is expected only after release.
Direct document probe/metadata waits before HTML are timing evidence, not missing-loader failures.

A separate no-routing context is used for image cache verification.
Browser steps never submit reports or invoke application write APIs.
